name: web-blue-project-cover-with-giant-website-industries-and-hero-phone
title: Royal blue cover with giant 'WEBSITE' and 'INDUSTRIES' words above and below a phone showing a dark portrait shop
whatItIs: A cobalt background with a huge pale-blue 'WEBSITE' at the top and a white heavy 'INDUSTRIES' at the bottom edge, a centred phone showing a dark store hero with a man holding a helmet, dashed circles with sparkle stars and small left and right captions (E-commerce, November 2025, designer name).
whatItMeans: Bold and simple; the giant labels sandwich the phone as a clear project cover.
techniques: Sandwich a phone between two giant words.
Trace dashed circles with sparkle nodes.
Add small captions at the sides.

vocabulary.definition: Giant words above and below an object.
A four-point star on a line.
Small text in left and right columns.
